name: MS-200D+
summary: A ZD2 pedal (stock effects are .ZD2 files); custom effects are not started. Its patch SysEx protocol (PTCF/EDTB) is read, decoded and written on hardware, the write confirmed through a power cycle.

research.label: thammer/zoom-explorer
research.note: MIT, by Thomas Hammer. The EDTB chunk's byte-reversed bitstream layout (on/off, 29-bit effect id, per-slot parameters) and its encoder, which this pedal's write path ports from, round-trip verified byte-identical across a full factory patch library before any hardware write.

research.label: mungewell/zoom-zt2
research.note: MIT, by Simon Wood. decode_preset.py's Construct definitions for the PTCF/TXJ1/TXE1 patch container confirm the chunk layout read from this pedal; its SysEx tools are written for other ZD2 pedals and are not yet tried on this one.
